name: baby-bash
description: Full-screen keyboard-mashing toy for babies: colour bursts and synth notes

paragraphs: A full-screen toy for babies who love to bash the keyboard. Every key or tap sets off a colour burst and plays a gentle synth note. Runs in any modern browser with nothing to install.
features: All notes are from C major pentatonic, so mashing always sounds musical.
Each key always makes the same colour and sound, so cause and effect are easy to learn.
Letters and digits appear large on screen. Space and Enter make a big burst and a chord.
Every 10th bash gets a little extra, and it grows: a star ring at 10, a rainbow sweep at 25, a big sun, moon, heart or star floating up at 50, and fireworks at 100.

Spell a word and it appears with a picture, lighting up letter by letter with a note each: cat dog cow pig bee duck fish, sun moon star tree ball car, mama dada papa nana baby, and the names Jack, Quinn, Elizabeth,…
